title: TMP Camera Surveillance Next 2.20.73
summary: Visual Kiosk grid editor with authenticated camera thumbnails, left-hand camera palette, drag-and-drop tile assignment and no extra live streams.
changes: Visual searchable camera thumbnail palette on the left of Kiosk layout editor
Drag-and-drop cameras onto grid slots and swap two occupied slots
Click-to-select camera and place into tile; dropdown/clear controls remain accessible
Lightweight lazy snapshots without additional video streams, max two simultaneous camera requests
Persist layouts with existing version 1 schema, keep recordings, motion and stream configuration unchanged
name: TMP Camera Surveillance Next v2.20.73
description: Visual kiosk camera placement and lightweight snapshot thumbnails, preserving existing layouts and central media architecture.
releaseNotes: Upgrade from 2.20.32. Kiosk layout manager now provides a searchable left camera thumbnail palette and right-hand drag-and-drop grid. Snapshot previews are lazy, limited to two concurrent authenticated requests and aborted/cleaned up on close. Click/keyboard/dropdown alternatives, swap, clear and previous saved layouts remain supported. Preserves existing 2.20.72 HLS replay fix, patched go2rtc broker, recordings/motion and database.
